digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI on GitHub Actions
propositions: Gerrit Verified wall-clock time increased from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes; the regression is decomposed into +14m31s pytest test growth (12,341 tests vs 8,430 tests) and contention-amplified subprocess/APFS workload nonlinearity on macOS runners under org queueing limits.

Mutation testing selector landed at commit e0b3fdfc8e and was skipped in 57/62 post-landing runs with no measured critical-path extension; mutation is rejected as the direct cause and accounts for only 8% of sample when active.

Five named unit tests execute expensive mechanics repeatedly: 120s Jira missing-field timeout, five captured 5s sleeps in capability/audit paths, repeated 5xx backoff, redundant AST parsing calls (84s vs 23s with caching), and wiki corpus per-worker recomputation (321.6–495.6s aggregate).

Execution time decomposition from run 31752047186 shows macOS default pytest at 22m15s critical path with 12,914 tests, plus distributed residual work; wiki corpus setup (149.13s), hourly-cadence bridge (130.59s py3.11), and provenance setup (46.95–49.02s) are measured long poles.

Root-cause remediation is decomposed into seven linked tracker tickets targeting fake clocks, injected sleepers, AST caching, wiki corpus xdist recomputation, import benchmark optimization, and socket/process timing windows while preserving all coverage and test contracts.
Existing --durations=25 observability proved sufficient for RCA; no new observability code change was required or merged.
